title.narrative: Marcos éticos para las tecnologías emergentes / Ethical Framework for Emergence Technologies

description.narrative: The aim is to strengthen the Ecuadorian government’s capacity to design and implement inclusive, gender-sensitive national policies and regulatory frameworks, in line with UNESCO’s recommendations. It also supports legislative initiatives being pursued to address emerging challenges in bioethics and the ethics of science and technology, in accordance with the guidelines of the International Bioethics Committee (IBC) and the World Commission on the Ethics of Scientific Knowledge and Technology (COMEST). Through technical assistance, multi-stakeholder dialogues, and policy tools, the project promotes ethical frameworks adapted to national realities, with an emphasis on the participation of women, indigenous peoples, and other historically excluded groups. In addition, through participatory diagnostic processes, training for decision-makers and key civil society actors, and the development of national roadmaps, the aim is to promote climate policies that respect human rights, social justice, transparency, and accountability.
